Line or code reference: line 6785, inside the elif [ "${EDITOR_NOOP_RECOVERABLE_FAILURE:-false}" = "true" ] branch (lines 6782-6793): editor_attempts="$(ls -1 "${PREVIOUS_REVIEWS_DIR}"/editor_attempt_*.err 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')"
Problem: this assignment is missing the || true guard that the functionally identical line 6786 directly below it carries (last_err_file=... || true). The step has no shell: override and the workflow has no defaults.run.shell, so it runs under GitHub Actions' default bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail. If PREVIOUS_REVIEWS_DIR exists (passing the -d guard at line 6784) but contains no editor_attempt_*.err files, the glob stays literal, ls exits 2, pipefail propagates the failure through wc/tr, the assignment returns non-zero, and set -e terminates the step before tg_send_tracked (line 6808) and the gh api comment call (line 6815).
Why it fails at runtime: the producer side tolerates the .err files' absence explicitly — scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh copies them with 2>/dev/null || true at lines 2108, 2123, 2133, and 2423, and the same script's own identical glob at line 2556 (final_editor_err) also uses || true; both outputs are lost when the step terminates.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
